achiever.name: Achiever
achiever.description: You have a strong drive for accomplishment and work hard to achieve your goals. You have great stamina and take satisfaction from being productive and crossing things off your to-do list.
characteristics: Sense of accomplishment from completing tasks
potentialWeaknesses: May judge others by their productivity
actionItems: Set meaningful goals that energize you
Track your accomplishments to maintain motivation
Partner with people who can help you prioritize

activator.name: Activator
activator.description: You make things happen by turning thoughts into action. You're impatient for action and believe that action is the best way to learn.
potentialWeaknesses: May start projects without finishing them
actionItems: Seek roles where you can initiate projects
Channel your energy toward important goals
Practice explaining your rationale for action
